message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for this case.

Facts: Defendant Zhang gave kickbacks (bribes) to project managers (Liu and Huang) after obtaining construction contracts. This is bribery: giving money to state employees? Are they state employees? They are project comprehensive department deputy general manager and project engineering (supervision) department deputy manager of a real estate development company (Fuding Biyu Garden Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.). This is a private enterprise, not a state organ. So the participants are not state officials. The crime is giving bribes (offering bribe) to private sector personnel. The label "受贿" is for receiving bribes. Here the defendant is giving bribe (行贿). The correction lessons mention "受贿" vs "非国家工作人员受贿". But we need to see if there is a label for "行贿". The list of possible labels includes "受贿", "行贿"? In examples, they used "行贿" for bribery (the one where defendant gave bribe). Example: earlier case with Huang gave 3万元 to Yu, label "行贿". So we should use "行贿". Also there may be "滥用职权" but that's for officials. Not applicable.

Thus final answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: maybe "非法经营"? No. It's just bribery.
